name: EJ Christian Medilo
aboutSummary: I’m EJ Christian Medilo, a fourth-year BSIT student at STI College Global City and an aspiring software developer. I build full-stack web and Android applications, learning through practical projects.
aiApproach: I use AI to support development planning, code analysis, troubleshooting, research, implementation, and learning.
aiLearning: I’m exploring AI engineering and building my foundations through study and practical experimentation.
intro: I build web and Android applications that connect clear interfaces, useful workflows, and reliable data.
summary: I am a fourth-year BSIT student and aspiring software developer with hands-on experience building full-stack web and Android applications. I developed STI Vio-Log, a student discipline and community service management system, and led development of Kwiztorya, a Philippine history learning application. My experience includes React, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Java, API integration, and application security, with a growing interest in AI engineering.
goal: I’m strengthening my full-stack development practice: designing clear interfaces, building reliable APIs, and deploying applications that solve practical problems. I’m also exploring how AI can support useful software experiences.
interests: I’m interested in AI and emerging technologies: discovering new tools, experimenting with AI-assisted development, and understanding how technology can improve software and user experiences.
hobbies: Outside development, I enjoy online games, movies, and anime. Gaming gives me a mix of competitive and collaborative experiences; movies and anime let me explore different stories, characters, and creative worlds.
workWithMe: I’m open to software development opportunities and collaboration on practical web and Android projects. I enjoy working with other developers, learning through real problems, and exploring emerging technology.
